description: Return a base64-encoded PNG thumbnail of the current lot via the headless renderer. Bot must be on a lot; returns error:not-on-lot if in city mode. Render timeout is 2s; returns error:render-timeout if exceeded. Size limit 256KB; PNG is downsampled to fit if needed.
call_signatures: cf $CF get-lot-thumbnail   # returns {ok:true, thumbnail:<base64-PNG>, size_bytes:<N>} or {ok:false, error:<reason>}

response_fields.thumbnail: string — base64-encoded PNG of the current lot view (present when ok=true)
response_fields.size_bytes: int — byte length of the raw PNG before base64 encoding (present when ok=true)
response_fields.error: string — error category on failure: 'not-on-lot', 'render-timeout', or a freeform diagnostic message

common_mistakes: Bot must be on a lot (joined via visit-lot); calling from city mode returns ok=false, error=not-on-lot.
Render timeout is 2s. On a complex lot the renderer may not respond in time; error=render-timeout is returned instead of hanging.
Output PNG is guaranteed ≤256KB. Very large lots are downsampled automatically.
perception_hints: Use for periodic capture cadence (see docs/operating-mode.md). At 1 Hz perception the lot visual state updates rarely; polling more than once per minute is rarely useful.
The returned PNG is from the same renderer pipeline as take-screenshot but with no permission gate and no rate-limit per lot.
